answer: In PoA, each interaction contributes to a reputation score whose exponential temporal decay imposes a defined half-life: identities must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity prevent isolated praise rings from amplifying one another. A freshly spawned sybil therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality, whether named yarrow, oasis, or lagoon, and lacks the trusted pathways required to pass consensus.
